candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits one complete executable policy capsule. The final call consumes that capsule and reopens every common input simultaneously. The capsule remains visible as evidence but carries no preservation authority; the final call emits the lineage's single policy.
candidate_structure.name: Defeasible Predecessor Sovereignty Edge
candidate_structure.organization: two-call sequential lineage with one complete executable predecessor and one terminal full-context authority reset

calls.objective: Reconcile the initially visible evidence and obligations into one complete executable policy artifact whose commitments remain explicitly open to terminal reconsideration.

Consume originate_defeasible_predecessor with all common evidence co-visible, treat inherited commitments as defeasible evidence rather than preserved state, resolve visible conflicts once, and emit one complete policy.

mode_certificate.forbidden_inherited_mechanism: custodial in-place reconciliation of an authoritative executable artifact under disjoint reentry windows
mode_certificate.independent_replacement_principle: A single full-context sovereignty edge preserves predecessor visibility while removing predecessor authority.
rejected_assumptions: A policy-bearing predecessor must remain authoritative for its successor.
External evidence should be partitioned into mutually exclusive downstream windows.
Incremental custodial continuity is necessary for coherent terminal policy authority.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Replace the downstream custodial chain with one full-context sovereignty edge: the predecessor remains a complete executable artifact but becomes defeasible evidence, while the terminal call alone rebinds policy authority with all common inputs co-visible.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Removing commitment inertia and partial-view ordering should make phase-shift adaptation and scan resistance more coherent while reducing distortion of the object-hit versus byte-hit tradeoff.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The active family gives inherited executable commitments presumptive authority while evidence arrives through mutually exclusive windows, making reconciliation path-dependent even when each transition is locally coherent.

structural_mutation.after: One complete executable predecessor crosses a single edge where all common evidence is co-visible and predecessor commitments lose presumptive authority before terminal emission.
structural_mutation.before: A complete executable artifact retains presumptive authority while successive custodians reconcile it through disjoint evidence windows.
structural_mutation.factor: full-context successor sovereignty over a defeasible executable predecessor
structural_mutation.why_structural: The mutation changes edge authority, external-evidence visibility, and state-transition semantics from custodial continuation to full-context rebasing; these are consequences of one sovereignty-edge factor rather than role renaming.

validation.factor: full-context successor sovereignty over a defeasible executable predecessor

policy_bearing_output_kinds.executor_semantics: complete policy artifact plus obligation evidence on the same single lineage
